quote: This year feels really long, like I have been in this school forever.
I remember the year by the trips: the zoo, then the swimming day, then Christmas.
After my birthday it went a bit faster.
The weeks take ages, especially in winter.
Every morning is the same: bus, school, lunch, homework.
We always have German first on Monday, it's always the same.
Even the holidays were the same every day, I just played.
My mum says I say 'same as always' all the time.
Nothing really changes from week to week.
Same bus driver, same seat, same jokes.
Primary school ended a really long time ago.
The sleepover with my class was the best day, everything before it feels far away.
Honestly, it went fast, I can't believe it's already summer.
The football tournament was in the middle, that's how I remember it.
Year 11 and 12 just disappeared.
Everything is about the Abitur now, I count in weeks.
The trip to London is the only thing I clearly remember from last year.
Every year goes faster than the one before.
The days are the same, so the weeks blur together.
I'm always thinking about what I'll do after school.
This year drags. Every week takes forever.
I'm just waiting for the Abitur to be over so my real life can start.
When you're only waiting for something, the time in between never ends.
It's crazy how fast this went, I still feel like I just started Year 10.
Applications, driving licence, moving out – my head is always in next year.
School is pretty much the same every day.
